1.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
1.asv: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.

2.web: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked devices.
2.asv: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

3.web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
3.asv: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

4.web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
4.asv: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

5.web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
5.asv: The thoughts of the righteous are just; Butthe counsels of the wicked are deceit.

6.web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
6.asv: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

7.web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
7.asv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.

8.web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
8.asv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

9.web: Better is he who is lightly esteemed, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
9.asv: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.

10.web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
10.asv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

11.web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
11.asv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain persons is void of understanding.

12.web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
12.asv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

13.web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
13.asv: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.

14.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
14.asv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

15.web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
15.asv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.

16.web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
16.asv: A fool’s vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.

17.web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
17.asv: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.

18.web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
18.asv: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.

19.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
19.asv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.

20.web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
20.asv: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.

21.web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
21.asv: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.

22.web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
22.asv: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.

23.web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
23.asv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

24.web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
24.asv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.

25.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
25.asv: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.

26.web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
26.asv: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.

27.web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
27.asv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of menis tothe diligent.

28.web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
28.asv: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
